prompt: A code editor window lying flat on an engraved nautical chart seen straight from above, a flat printed map with no horizon, no sky and no perspective, the window drawn in crisp off-white line art with a title bar and three small dots, inside it unfinished code drawn as solid rounded bars, abstract bars and never characters, of varying length that stop halfway down, a block caret waiting after the last dash. Richly detailed engraved nautical chart style, like a fine antique sea chart printed in two inks: the charted water built from many layers of fine parallel hatching, line density increasing towards the deep water to give depth, tonal bands from deep cerulean at the bottom to lighter cerulean at the top, bathymetric contour lines with small depth soundings drawn as tiny dots, a delicate compass rose with fine tick marks in a corner. Crisp sharp lines of several weights, intricate but calm, premium print quality, high detail, elegant. No realistic objects, no photographic rendering, no glow, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, full-bleed edge to edge, no border, no frame, the window on the left third, open charted water on the right. Palette strictly limited to medium cerulean ocean blue #0072a8 and its tints and shades, off-white #fbfcfd, ink grey #13212b and a touch of seaweed green #5d7a6a.
